text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Standard Minimum Perumahan,

Penginapan dan Kemudahan Pekerja (Peletakhakan Kuasa) (No. 6) 2021.

Peletakhakan kuasa

2. Menteri meletak hak pada—

(a) pegawai yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual Pertama kuasa yang diberikan

kepada Ketua Pengarah di bawah perenggan 24C(1)(a), (b), (c) dan (e),

subseksyen 24C(3), seksyen 24FA dan 24FB, seksyen 27 dan

subseksyen 28A(2); dan

(b) pegawai yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual Kedua kuasa yang diberikan

kepada Ketua Pengarah di bawah perenggan 24C(1)(a), (b), (c)

dan (e), dan seksyen 27.

EMPLOYEES' MINIMUM STANDARDS OF HOUSING, ACCOMMODATIONS

AND AMENITIES ACT 1990

EMPLOYEES' MINIMUM STANDARDS OF HOUSING, ACCOMMODATIONS

AND AMENITIES (VESTING OF POWERS) (NO. 6) ORDER 2021

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 26(1) of the

Employees' Minimum Standards of Housing, Accommodations and Amenities 1990

[Act 446], the Minister makes the following order:

Name

1. This order may be cited as the Employees' Minimum Standards of Housing,

Accommodations and Amenities (Vesting of Powers) (No. 6) Order 2021.

Vesting of powers

2. Minister vests in—

(a) the officers specified in the First Schedule the powers conferred upon

the Director General under paragraphs 24C(1)(a), (b), (c) and (e),

subsection 24C(3), sections 24FA and 24FB, section 27 and

subsection 28A(2); and

(b) the officers specified in the Second Schedule the powers conferred upon

the Director General under paragraphs 24C(1)(a), (b), (c) and (e), and

section 27.
